recognize_zh: 高倍免疫組織化學染色下，瀰漫片狀的中型淋巴樣細胞幾乎全部呈現胞質／膜狀棕色陽性，核為圓形至略不規則；在 T-PLL 的脈絡下可能為 TCL1 或 T 細胞標記，但圖上未標示抗體名稱，無法單憑本圖確定。
features: Diffuse sheet of medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei
Nearly all cells show cytoplasmic/membranous brown chromogen staining
Nuclei mostly unstained to weakly stained with hematoxylin counterstain
Uniform, monotonous population without an obvious admixed negative population
Occasional fat space at the edge of the field
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain at high power shows a diffuse, monotonous infiltrate of medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei, nearly all of which show cytoplasmic and membranous staining. The antibody is not labeled in this image. In the context of T-prolymphocytic leukemia, diffuse positivity for TCL1 or a pan-T-cell marker such as CD3 or CD7 would support infiltration by the neoplastic T cells. Correlation with the specific marker, flow cytometry and TCL1A/MTCP1 rearrangement studies is required.

ddx.dx: B-cell prolymphocytic leukemia / splenic B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: B-cell neoplasms are CD20/PAX5-positive and TCL1 staining may be present, so the T-cell lineage must be shown by CD3 and flow cytometry.
Sezary cells are typically TCL1-negative with cerebriform nuclei, often CD7-negative and CD26-negative.
ATLL shows flower cells, is CD25-positive with HTLV-1 serology, and lacks TCL1A rearrangement.
